input.evidence: The boxed animal is the cow at the back of the pair. She is lying on her chest with her head up, and there is a white or pale tag in the ear facing the camera. There are no white markings on her body. A second cow is lying flat on her side in front of her and overlaps the box. All three reference crops (Cow01, Cow06, Cow03) were unavailable, so I could not compare tag colour, ear side, markings or size against anything. At -20 s and +20 s she is still lying in the same spot, away from the bunk and the waterer. Her ears looked normal and her head was up. I saw no discharge.
input.self_check: I checked her posture at -20 s and +20 s with look_sequence, and it was the same both times. The chew test failed ('too few frames'), so I can't rule rumination in or out. If she was chewing cud, the right label would be ruminating_lying instead of lying. I can't resolve her identity without the reference images. The tracker's pick of Cow01 had only a 0.05 margin and I could not check it, so I am not confirming any candidate. Since the box overlaps the cow in front, it may also have meant that cow, who was likewise lying.
